title: God Made Me in His Image
bigIdea: You are made in God's image — made to be like Him.

memoryVerse.text: How you made me is amazing and wonderful.

moral.lesson: When God made people, He made us in His own image. That means we can love, create, help, and forgive — just like God does. When you are kind and loving, you show others a little picture of what God is like.
moral.application: You carry God's likeness inside you. So today, you can choose to be kind, patient, and forgiving — and show people how good God is.

style: Flat-color children's cartoon storybook illustration, simple rounded shapes, soft warm colors, thick clean black outlines, bright and friendly, gentle lighting, 16:9 landscape composition, no text or words in the image, no letters.

beats.scene: A warm glowing sky over a beautiful new world, with soft golden light shining down onto a happy man and woman standing below, as if lovingly created.
text: When God made people, He did something very special.
He said, “Let us make them in our image, to be like us.”

beats.scene: A cheerful young child with short brown hair happily painting a colorful picture and building with blocks, being creative, in a bright room.
text: Being made in God's image means we can do things like God does.
We can create, imagine, and make beautiful things.

beats.scene: The same brown-haired child gently hugging and comforting a sad friend, showing kindness and care, warm and tender.
text: God is loving, kind, patient, and forgiving.
Because we are made like Him, we can be loving and kind too.

beats.scene: The brown-haired child sharing food and helping another child up, both smiling, with other kids playing kindly together in the background.
text: When you share, help, and forgive,
you show other people a little picture of what God is like.

beats.scene: The brown-haired child standing happily with a soft warm glow around their heart, smiling, looking proud and loved.
text: You carry something very special inside you —
You were made to show His love to the world.
